text:
customer_mark: Hey support — our trial credits dropped from 5k to 300 this morning, looks like a background job consumed them... I think it's the nightly embed/rerank job. Any idea?

support_anna: Sorry about that! Can you paste the org id and last 4 of API key? we'll check logs and possible retries.

customer_mark: Org: org_9XK, key last4: ab12. Job is `doc-sync->embeddings` scheduled at 03:00 UTC. It ran 4x between 03:00 and 03:06 according to our logs.

support_anna: Thanks — can you confirm whether you applied a promo code yesterday? sometimes promo post-processing can trigger requeues.

customer_mark: Yep promo 'NEWTRIAL50' applied at 02:50. It showed as applied in UI but billing still shows trial active then dropped.

support_anna: digging in now, looping eng.

eng_miguel: I see a flood of 429 retries to /v1/embeddings endpoint from service account svc-docs-sync (ip 10.2.5.3) starting 03:00. Worker crashed on a 502 then our retry middleware retriggered the batch. Logs:
```
2026-02-14T03:00:01Z ERROR batcher: shard timeout -> retrying batch id=b-98765 attempts=1
2026-02-14T03:00:04Z WARN http: upstream 502 -> queue re-enqueue job=job-1222
```
The kicker: scheduler-bot also requeued the same job due to a mis-evaluated 'promo_applied' check returning false for a short window.

infra_jaya: config diff shows cron replicas in us-west and eu-west both enabled and both using `--assume-role=sync` after a failed deploy earlier — idempotency key wasn't persisted to the shared DB so duplicates occurred.

eng_miguel: Repro steps: 1) schedule job, 2) simulate transient 502 on embeddings cluster, 3) have scheduler re-evaluate promo application endpoint which returns 500 for ~20s -> scheduler requeues -> worker retry -> duplicate submits -> token burn.

support_anna: Mitigation we did: paused doc-sync schedule for org_9XK, forced job dedupe in queue, issued emergency refund for 4.6k credits to org_9XK (billing_liz please confirm). Patch queued to add durable idempotency via job.uuid persisted to DB and check promo application before dispatch.

billing_liz: Confirmed: refunded 4600 trial credits and incremented trial balance back to 5k. Also flagged account for manual audit. ETA for customer-facing note: 30m.

customer_mark: Thanks all. Can you also add rate-limits on retries? This burned our credit reserve during the night.

eng_miguel: Adding exponential backoff cap and a retry budget per-org. Will propose PR this afternoon.

support_anna: Follow-up: will DM you the refund txn id and the steps we took. Closing thread when you confirm credits are correct.

customer_mark: Received refund id refund_7721, balance back to 5k, looks good. Appreciate the quick fix :thumbsup:
